Need to search first.I couldn't write any of the Esther 7 notes, because I didn't manage to read a single source page.

**What happened**
- **First attempt failed:** I tried to open the six main pages directly: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Ellicott, Gill, the Pulpit Commentary and Matthew Henry on Bible Hub. The tool refused all six because a page has to turn up in a search before it can be opened.
- **Second attempt was blocked:** I then sent a set of searches to find those pages. The system stopped them because I had used up my research tool calls for this turn, so no results came back.

**Why the notes are empty**
Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to leave out what I couldn't find. Since I read nothing, every verse, tradition and alternative view would have to come from my own memory, so I've left them all blank.

**Next step**
If you send the request again in a new message, I'll search first, then read the verse-by-verse pages. After that I'll check the tradition-specific and "other views" sites and write the notes as "v. 1: …" through "v. 10: …" with a link for each point.
